title: Obzly overview
description: Seed dashboard for Obzly's own /metrics (Phase 14 item 7). Pairs with deploy/observability/prometheus/obzly-rules.yaml.

panels.title: Ingest responses by status
panels.description: 429 = per-project rate limit; 5xx should stay at zero.

panels.title: Ingest buffer batches (JetStream)
panels.description: Batches held in each JetStream ingest stream, awaiting workers (INGEST_BUFFER=jetstream).

panels.title: Ingest buffer fill
panels.description: At 100% new batches are rejected (429) until workers catch up. Empty unless INGEST_BUFFER=jetstream.

panels.title: Replicas lagging
panels.description: Replicas offline or behind; losing one more broker would lose quorum.

panels.title: Rows held in RAM
panels.description: Lost on a hard kill until flushed.

panels.title: Rows lost to failed flushes
panels.description: Any non-zero value is data loss; check disk space.

panels.title: Upload lag (oldest pending segment)
panels.description: A pending segment exists only on one replica's disk.

panels.title: Segment reads/s by source
panels.description: object_store = cold-cache miss; missing = unreadable segment skipped; pending = written on another replica and not uploaded yet (its rows come from the JetStream tail).

panels.title: Time since last successful pass
panels.description: Compaction runs every 5 min; alerts above 15 min.

panels.title: DuckDB memory by handle
panels.description: Each DuckDB handle defaults to a memory_limit of 80% of RAM.

panels.title: Postgres pool
panels.description: N replicas x pool must stay under Postgres max_connections.

panels.title: Planned bytes per query p95 by stream
Alert notifications/s by result
panels.description: sent, retried, silenced, failed (gave up after every attempt)

panels.title: Rule to notification p95
panels.description: From a rule firing to its notification being sent

panels.title: Access decisions/s
panels.description: authz decisions by action and result; denials are also audit-logged

panels.title: Integrity audit
panels.description: The last audit's sampled segments and failures (missing, resized, unreadable)
